title: Death Riders
description: A gang leader named Reaper brings his bikers on a treasure hunt through the desert while an undercover cop follows in hot pursuit.

description: An unlucky thief makes a friend in prison and from there goes hunting for buried gold.

description: Mexican bandit brothers (Gian Maria Volonte, Klaus Kinski) lure a U.S. mercenary (Lou Castel) to join their revolution, complicated by an assassination plot.

title: West of Hell
description: A gunslinger, a vengeful ex-slave and a runaway discover their train is haunted by a sinister force.

title: Companeros
description: An arms dealer needs to rob a bank in order to make a delivery.

description: Two con artists (James Mason, Gina Lollobrigida) bring an outlaw (Lee Van Cleef) into their scheme to bilk the Mexican government out of $1 million.

title: Another
description: After a chain of deaths at a junior high school, new transfer student Koichi turns to a mysterious girl who holds the key to the dark mystery.

title: Freckled Max and the Spooks
description: Young orphan Max leaves the circus to escape his abusive fosters. Taking refuge in a desolate castle, he gets acquainted with the most unlikely company: a vampire, a werewolf, the Frankenstein monster and an extraordinary old lady.
